plainText:
Graham Halstead is a voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with Ann Wright Representatives.

==Biography==
Halstead was born and raised in Virginia and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during where he voiced Character of the day Locke. He later gained a more notable role in the form of recurring character Kanoa. Halstead is now living and working in Brooklyn, New York City.
